study.question: Does the incremental last-24-coordinate gain of r0033-gap_factorized_symmetric require observed cross-action adjacency, or can exchangeable timestamp-group composition modulated by relative-gap heterogeneity explain it? Does removing gap modulation reproduce the gain through redundant feature parameterization?
study.hypothesis: The factorized/symmetric winner may benefit from action-composition interactions with relative-gap heterogeneity rather than binding specific action transitions to elapsed gaps. Replace only its last24 features with h*E, where E is the exact uniform timestamp-group-permutation expectation of action adjacency and h is the inherited mean relative-gap weight. Predict that h*E retains or improves validation AUC and outperforms E alone. This is a prospective local hypothesis; one seed and selected validation history do not establish it.

nearest_work.difference: Retain the field-adapted activation ancestry. DIN describes target-dependent activation, explicitly abandons softmax normalization and reports an unsuccessful LSTM experiment; inherited local reference uses normalized attention, category/brand substitutions and later deterministic statistics. New branch is an exchangeable group-composition/relative-gap interaction, not DIN reproduction or a claim that order is universally useless.

Only author README inspected; publisher full text unavailable. README confirms history has category, brand and behavior type but no item. No item journey, user-item path, auxiliary matching loss or full DMR reproduction is claimed.

Existing last24 inputs are .5*h*Sym(M) on common target/activity support, with both off-diagonal directions duplicated. New candidate replaces Sym(M) with exchangeable E. Two unit-modulation replacements remove h. Earlier sequential features remain intact, so this addresses only the additional branch.

Scratch full first-six-day training,3 epochs,batch4096,Adam/BCE,seed42, natural prevalence and frozen validation scorer.
study.proposed_difference: A replacement factorial uses pairing in {adjacent,composition} and modulation in {relative,unit}. On the inherited common support and same off-diagonal coordinates, adjacent_relative=.5*h*Sym(M) is existing r0033-gap_factorized_symmetric; adjacent_unit=.5*Sym(M); composition_relative=.5*h*E is the candidate; composition_unit=.5*E. Only the final24 inputs differ, without adding trainable capacity. E is exactly the uniform timestamp-group-permutation expectation, not an event shuffle. Unit is an intervention h=1, not equal-gap h=.5. Both full pair matrices sum to1 but off-diagonal masses differ. All three new modules compute all4 readouts, and preserve the original incumbent calculation for the existing cell. No priority or broad novelty claim: available primary search for temporal/sequence nearest work returned no extra sources, leaving wider priority unverified.
predictions: Primary prospective contrast: composition_relative AUC exceeds composition_unit; secondary AUC of composition_relative retains or improves .6209487954658293 from existing adjacent_relative. Logloss must also be reported; a worse Logloss prevents an unqualified overall improvement claim.

Adjacent_relative exceeds adjacent_unit if the inherited h interaction carries incremental predictive value beyond a duplicated symmetric linear readout. If both relative-minus-unit contrasts are positive across paired seeds, gap modulation has stronger conditional support; compare their difference to assess interaction with pairing.

Composition_relative versus adjacent_relative measures whether observed adjacency is needed in this added branch, conditional on the complete retained sequential parent; no whole-model order-invariance claim follows.

Host diagnostics should give finite [B] logits and <=64 finite scalars; prefix/support/missing/empty identity errors zero, matrix mass/symmetry/modulation errors within float32 tolerance about1e-5, unchanged17147683 parameters. h is scale-invariant and lies in[.5,1] when gaps exist. E and Sym(M) must differ on at least some supported examples for pairing to be discriminating.

Report wall/GPU cost, memory and inference latency/throughput from host receipts; small additional matrix encodings should not be called an efficiency improvement. First512 diagnostics describe only that fixed sample and do not estimate predictive benefit.
falsifiers: Composition_relative fails to exceed composition_unit, or unit-modulation replacements match/exceed the incumbent: predictive evidence does not support the proposed gap interaction; possible redundant-parameterization or optimization explanation remains.

Composition_relative materially loses to the existing adjacent_relative, especially under paired repetitions: reject composition sufficiency for this added branch without claiming to refute every composition mechanism.

Pairing matrices/features are equal on all supported samples, or h is essentially constant: this suite lacks the variation needed for the proposed distinction; diagnostic presence alone is not usefulness.

Finite/shape/support/prefix checks fail, initial logits/RNG or parameter counts differ, or resource cap exceeded: implementation or cost failure, not scientific refutation. Retain failure receipt and charge any diagnostic/retry.
One-seed differences disappear/reverse across paired seeds or user-cluster intervals include zero: retain preliminary/null result rather than claim a mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Many prior validation-selected rounds create selection optimism; seed42 alone cannot establish significance or transfer. No user-level predictions/bootstrap interface is available in this coding phase.

Symmetric directed coordinates are duplicates, and adjacent_unit is a linear combination of inherited directed inputs. Removing or changing h also changes feature scale and Adam optimization despite matched parameters and zero initialization; a positive relative contrast alone is not causal mechanism identification. A later scale-matched or additive-h replacement is needed if this remains consequential.

E removes observed action ordering but changes cross-action off-diagonal mass as well as pair allocation. Differences may reflect persistence/composition and timestamp tie mixtures; no isolation of individual pairs or event-level action causation.
The full retained parent already contains chronological action and match-switch statistics; this experiment only diagnoses the last branch, not whether all history ordering can be discarded.

Common target-support gate selects only part of validation; .4013671875 of field coordinates in first512 supported. First512 have four empty histories and unequal category303/brand108 support. Small diagnostics may be unrepresentative.

h describes heterogeneity of observed gaps and can reflect truncation, user activity or static snapshot leakage assumptions; it is invariant to uniform positive age scaling and does not encode absolute temporal density.
Provided snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; causal prefix enforcement does not verify production point-in-time static attributes. Limited history128 and missing item IDs bound interpretation.
